contract: GET /public/share/:slug/cover. Serve a share cover with image MIME/cache behavior and share expiry checks; missing/expired share or cover denies without arbitrary-file access.
exceptions: force is not applicable: no share management or public consumer route has a force, hard or refresh/override mode.

invariants.contract: GET /public/share/:slug/cover requires the share_session_id cookie (404 without), an open share and a session bound to that share, and a session coverPath (404 when the item has no cover). Success serves the item's cover file as image/jpeg with Accept-Ranges: bytes, an ETag and Last-Modified; If-None-Match with the returned ETag answers 304 with no body while a different tag returns the image. Deleted or expired shares answer 404 without image bytes. With USE_X_ACCEL the route answers 204 with X-Accel-Redirect naming the encoded absolute cover path and no body.
